answer: The 2010 Fields Medalists are Elon Lindenstrauss (born in Jerusalem, Israel; studied at Hebrew University of Jerusalem), Ngô Bảo Châu (born in Hanoi, Vietnam; studied at École Normale Supérieure, Université de Paris-Sud, and Université Sorbonne Paris Nord), Stanislav Smirnov (born in Leningrad, Soviet Union; studied at Saint Petersburg State University and California Institute of Technology), and Cédric Villani (born in Brive-la-Gaillarde, France; studied at École Normale Supérieure and Université Pierre et Marie Curie).
